title: Mesh tab: honest, network-free, no probing
what:
As pass 1. mesh/view.js is pure (snapshot -> rows and sentences). mesh/index.js draws:
- header: 'aoide 0.0.26 · ~/.local/bin/aoide · aoided ● 3 ms', or a sentence saying it is not available
- nodes table: node · verified · grants · meshes · added · roster cached Xm ago, plus 'presence is not probed: ages are when each roster was last cached'
- the mesh --json drift
- the stage graph: counts and a list
- the outbox
- the audit/gate tail, polled every 5 s through the lane while visible
Remote strings are drawn as text only. Mail cards live in the notes tab, not here.
tests:
mesh.test.mjs over R2a's fixture copies:
- both registry shapes
- the not-available sentence
- hostile text stays a plain string (view.js returns strings, never markup)
live_check: fake perch on PORT=48128 with the fixtures; door mode keeps its 'peers' line.
risk: Stale ages are shown as stale, never as presence.
